notes: Owner AdamsCO_GIS; data last edited 2026-08-30. Covers the whole county: unincorporated polygons carry real zoning codes with CITY_NAME='Unincorporated'; each municipality is a single polygon whose ZONE_ is the upper-case city name (e.g. 'THORNTON') and CITY_NAME is the city. Treat ZONE_ == upper(CITY_NAME) as 'incorporated - query the city layer'. Municipal polygons present: Arvada, Aurora, Bennett, Brighton, Commerce City, Federal Heights, Lochbuie, Northglenn, Thornton, Westminster. No description field; LINK points to the county Development Standards and Regulations page.

City of Thornton ArcGIS Server (citydevweb). No description field; LINK holds a URL to the district page on thorntonco.gov. Other fields: ORDINANCE, ZONE_DATE, ZONED_FROM, CASE_NUM. Thornton also spans into Weld County; this layer covers the whole city. Ignore AGOL hits for 'Thornton zoning' owned by ssmma_master (Thornton, Illinois) and the Mead & Hunt consultant copy.

City of Westminster ArcGIS Server. NAME holds the PUD/development name (test returned 'SPYGLASSE POINTE'); also ORDINANCE, APPROVEDDATE. Much of the city is PUD, so ZONEDESC is often just 'Planned Unit Devel.' - NAME is the useful identifier. Layer covers the Jefferson County portion of Westminster too. Ignore 'VT Data - Westminster Zoning' (Westminster, Vermont).

Owner NorthglennCO_GIS. Parcel-based (zoning stored per parcel polygon, layer 'City of Northglenn Zoning'); data last edited 2026-09-24. Codes follow the current UDC (AG, CA, CG, IN, MC, MN, OS, PD, PF, RM-1, RM-2, RS-1, RS-2). Alternate with identical codes but older data (2024-03-27): https://services7.arcgis.com/JeS0Sns8Qnvm0GB9/arcgis/rest/services/NorthglennZoning/FeatureServer/0. Do NOT use the ZoneCode field on GoGov_Parcels_view/0 - it holds legacy pre-UDC codes (returned 'R-3' where the zoning layer returns 'RM-1'). Also skip the 'Zoning' service in the same org (legacy ZONECODE/ZONEDIST parcel schema).

Commerce City open-data Parcels layer; zoning is stored per parcel. PUD_NAME is filled only for PUD parcels (e.g. 'TURNBERRY' at -104.84,39.89) - there is no general description field. Also carries LU_CURRENT / LU_ENTITLED / LU_FUTURE (land use, not zoning) and OWNER. ZONING_CODE values include non-zoning markers: ADCO (Adams County enclave), SPLT (split), UNK, ROW, and null. UPDATED_ZONING_CODE is empty everywhere at test time. Alternate parcel-zoning layer: https://gisserver.c3gov.com/gisserver/rest/services/Applications/PF_Zoning_tmp/MapServer/0 (same field). The legacy server maps.c3gov.com (PropertyLookup/ZoningDistrict, still listed on AGOL) times out - do not use.

City of Brighton ArcGIS Server, layer 'Zoning'. PUD_name / PDName hold the PUD name where applicable; also ORDINANCE, ORD_DATE, Case_File. Same service: layer 3 Zoning Overlays, layer 2 Future Land Use (not zoning). Brighton also extends into Weld County; layer covers the whole city. The older agiso.brightonco.gov server returned no JSON.

NOT OFFICIAL. Federal Heights publishes no public GIS/zoning service (fedheights.org/planning has only PDF forms). This layer is a copy hosted by consultant Mead & Hunt, data last edited 2025-04-30; fields: jurisd, local_zon, date. Use as a best-effort answer and flag results as unofficial; confirm with Federal Heights Planning (https://www.fedheights.org/planning). The layer id is 9, not 0.

Owner 'arvada' (City of Arvada); data last edited 2026-10-18. One layer for all of Arvada (Jefferson + Adams portions). Test point is in the Adams County portion (confirmed CITY_NAME='Arvada' in the Adams County layer; that portion spans roughly lon -105.053 to -105.040, lat 39.801 to 39.824). Second Adams test: -105.0470,39.8120 -> PUD. Also GEN_ZONING (general class), MAXIMUM_HE, UNITS, ALLOWED_US (URL). The separate 'Land_Use_Plan' service is comprehensive plan, not zoning.

Owner bennett_admin (Town of Bennett); public view, last edited 2026-10-08. Field names are SWAPPED: ZoningType holds the short code (R-1) and ZoningCode holds the district name. Layer 3 is base zoning; layers 0-2 are overlay districts (Commercial Mixed Use, Main Street-Downtown, Residential Mixed Use). Bennett spans Adams and Arapahoe counties; the layer covers the whole town. Source service (non-view) is .../Zoning/FeatureServer/3 with extra fields County, SubdivisionName, ZoningCodeLink.
